title: DHMO Panel Size and the Capitation Withholding Share (Network Participation Agreements)
content:
A primary care dentist under the Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement, one of the **Network Participation Agreements**, is paid capitation for each assigned member. When Cascade books a continuing capitation withholding against that payment, the size of the panel the payment covers relieves the withholding share.

**Clause.** The panel relief to the continuing capitation withholding share is set by the number of assigned members the capitation payment pays for. That number is the capitation amount divided by the capitation rate of 11.85 USD per assigned member per month.

- 1500 members or more (the agreement's panel capacity) subtracts 15 share points.
- 1000 members or more but fewer than 1500 subtracts 8 share points.
- Fewer than 1000 members subtracts nothing.

## Which payment is read

The capitation payment is the agreement's most recent capitation payment on its remittances. Where two entries share the latest date, the one listed first on the agreement's ledger is taken. Its amount is divided by 11.85 USD to give the assigned members it pays for.

## Input, judgement and output

| Capitation amount (hypothetical) | Members paid for | Band | Share points subtracted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11826.30 USD | 998 | Fewer than 1000 | None |
| 11850.00 USD | 1000 | 1000 to 1499 | 8 |
| 17763.15 USD | 1499 | 1000 to 1499 | 8 |
| 17775.00 USD | 1500 | 1500 or more | 15 |
| 20145.00 USD | 1700 | 1500 or more | 15 |

The thresholds are inclusive at their lower edge. A payment for exactly 1000 members is in the middle band, and a payment for exactly 1500 members is in the top band.
